afterTest: The interviewer comes from system audio, you come from the microphone. Keeping them apart removes guesswork about who is speaking.
Saved microphone (not connected, using system default)

Capturing the interviewer from system audio is not available yet. Until then Careerloom listens to your microphone only, and the interviewer's questions are picked up when they are audible to it (use speakers, or answer practice questions out loud).
If the interviewer comes out of your speakers, your microphone picks them up and they appear twice.
